verdict.rationale: TrueLayer documents a self-serve quickstart: you create a free UK merchant account and complete a first test payment. It also documents Console access to client credentials and official SDKs for Node.js, Python, Java and .NET that automate request signing. Speed is unproven, the quickstart shows a test payment rather than a linked sandbox bank account, and the four languages may not cover every developer. missing for 10: evidence of a fast signup-to-sandbox time, a documented sandbox account-linking quickstart (as opposed to a test payment), SDK coverage beyond Node/Python/Java/.NET, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the onboarding flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can go from signup to my first linked sandbox account fast — self-serve API keys, a runnable quickstart, and client libraries in my language
